item.description: The deal, which is aimed at safeguarding Europe’s struggling auto sector, includes more flexibility with decarbonization rules and provides incentives for investment.

item.description: The demand sets up a public contest of wills with a government that has pledged to demilitarize the Iran-backed militant group.

item.description: One of the deadliest saboteurs in recent military history, Lt. Lev Stupnikov fed troop locations and battle plans to the enemy before making a daring escape.
